comment: The language parity of hyper: the implementations of the server (PHP, Python, Node), and the units that every one of them holds. The server implementations run the shared vectors of contracts/ and the public functions they have in common. The browser package is a separate component, not an implementation of the server spec (HR-98); its tests belong to the package itself and are outside this declaration.

tools.reason: test: the node tests of the repository tools of scripts/ (the verifier, the build, the publish and the check scripts), which implement no contract
test: the browser tests of the example board, which run the example application and implement no contract
test: the install test of the published packages, which consumes them and implements no contract
test: the output-file test of the virtiofs check of the repository tools, which implements no contract
test: the tests of the browser package, which is a separate component and not an implementation of the server spec (HR-98); they belong to the package itself
test: the package-data test of the Python distribution polyspec-hyper-server, which checks its pyproject.toml and its py.typed marker and implements no contract of the protocol
